983-2645-2872-3430.easyPrerequisites: Clever Conjurer doesn't have summoning sickness.
983-2645-2872-3430.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
983-2645-2872-3430.description:
Activate Temple of the False God by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Temple of the False God
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2034-5003-8162.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Aerid, adding {C}{C}.
When Aerid dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Aerid trigger, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Aerid from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it,
When Aerid enters, it triggers, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat.

1445-2279-3899-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2279-3899-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

394-586-864-2511-3125.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
394-586-864-2511-3125.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Desecrated Tomb.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5073-5220-6900-7918.description:
Cast Tinder Wall by paying its mana cost.
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1778-3652-5859-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1778-3652-5859-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

2033-5223-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
2033-5223-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
2033-5223-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2085-5434-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kelpie Guide.
Activate one of the Kelpie Guide tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kelpie Guide token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

3490-5231-6996-7399.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-5231-6996-7399.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

5137-5963-7308.description:
Activate Marvin using Mona Lisa's ability by tapping it, adding an amount of colored mana equal to Marvin's power.
Activate Marvin using Morphling's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1283-2440-4183-7220.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
1283-2440-4183-7220.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Glamermite with haste.
When the token Glamermite enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Glamermite trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Glamermite.
Repeat.

1090-2921-3817.description:
Cast Restoration Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Restoration Angel.
Resolve the Restoration Angel ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Restoration Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-2907-5411.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2907-5411.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Scute Swarm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Resolve the Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Scute Swarm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

3446-3532-5078-6607.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lorescale Coatl triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more charge counters on it

1978-4324-4563.description:
Animate Everflowing Chalice using Workshop Elders.
Activate Everflowing Chalice by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Everflowing Chalice.
Repeat from step 2.

997-2232-2792-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
997-2232-2792-6843.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Great Whale.
Repeat.

215-4010-4359-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-4010-4359-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

2104-2707-4183-6504.manaNeeded: {U}{R} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
2104-2707-4183-6504.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Conjurer's Bauble.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate the Conjurer's Bauble token by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Temporal Manipulation onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Temporal Manipulation from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2292-5263-6243.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero as an Angel with flying.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

81-1491-2757-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
81-1491-2757-6218.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Pheres-Band Tromper, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

185-2103-2501-3098-4914.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature with power 2 or greater.
You have not cast an instant or sorcery this turn.
185-2103-2501-3098-4914.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U} and sacrificing a creaature with power 2 or greater, targeting yourself.
Capture of Jingzhou's casualty ability and Skywise Teachings trigger.
Resolve the Capture of Jingzhou trigger, copying it, targeting yourself.
Resolve the Skywise Teachings trigger, causing you to pay {1}{U} to create a 2/2 Djinn Monk creature token.
Resolve both Capture of Jingzhous, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Cast Call to Mind by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing a Djinn Monk, targeting Mystic Retrieval.
Call to Mind's casualty ability and Skywise Teachings trigger.
Resolve the Call to Mind trigger, copying it, targeting Capture of Jingzhou.
Resolve the Skywise Teachings trigger, causing you to pay {1}{U} to create a 2/2 Djinn Monk creature token.
Resolve both Call to Minds, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat steps 1 through 6 one additional time.
Cast Mystic Retrieval by paying {3}{U} and sacrificing a Djinn Monk, targeting Call to Mind.
Mystic Retrieval's casualty ability and Skywise Teachings trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Retrieval trigger, copying it, targeting Capture of Jingzhou.
Resolve the Skywise Teachings trigger, creating a 2/2 Djinn Monk creature token.
Resolve both Mystic Retrievals, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Call to Mind from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.

719-1789-2232-2459.notablePrerequisites:
"Dragon" chosen with Xenograft.
You have enough mana to pay for commnader tax, if applicable.
719-1789-2232-2459.description:
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} plus commnander tax, if applicable.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Lathliss and Cloudstone Curio triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1429-2034-2169.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}, causing each creature you control to enter the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding {C}{C}.
Lesser Masticore dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counters due to Zameck Guildmage.
Repeat from step 2.

2762-3941-4853.notablePrerequisites: Thopter Squadron has at least two +1/+1 counters.
2762-3941-4853.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding three mana of any one color.
Activate Thopter Squadron first ability by paying {1} and removing +1/+1 counter, creating a 1/1 Thopter token.
Activate Thopter Squadron second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat.
